correctness.rationale: Complete exact finite proof: enumerate all 2^21 tournament orientations and exactly 2640 regular ones, build all directed-cycle moves, certify degree 14 and group orbits of sizes 240/720/1680, and BFS each orbit representative. Independent adjacency-row recursion enumerates all configurations and BFS checks every one of the 2640 roots. Both standalone program executions passed; the detailed loop invariants and assumptions appear in RESULT.md. No asymptotic inference from finite tests is claimed.

value.rationale: Shortest score-preserving transformation distances are a natural metric invariant of a classical finite interchange graph. The sharp distinction between two eccentricity regimes, 360 unique converse antipodes and a local four-vertex orbit test yield substantive classification beyond known connectivity, regularity or isomorphism-type count. Exact finite classifications require no general theorem to be meaningful.
